## FaultOptions.persistent property

When `true`<!-- -->, the fault keeps firing on every matching call until removed with [FaultPlan.clear()](./test-helpers.faultplan.clear.md)<!-- -->. When `false` (the default), the fault fires exactly once and then clears itself, so the next identical call succeeds normally.

**Signature:**

```typescript
persistent?: boolean;
```
